An '''Imperial demolitions primer''' was a document relating to the use of explosives. In the primer, it described a [[Shaped charge/Legends|shaped charge]] as an "explosive device fashioned to direct the explosive force of a detonation in a predetermined direction."<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
